records.source_span: As a physical education teacher and assistant softball coach at Guilford County Schools, I'm committed to building not just stronger athletes, but stronger individuals through discipline, teamwork, and positive mentorship. Having played four years as a starting shortstop at UNCG, I bring NCAA-level experience to my practices, focusing on fundamentals, game strategy, and mental toughness. I also emphasize athlete wellness off the field — for instance, during nutrition week, I lead my students in preparing fresh, balanced snacks, including a fun hands-on rice paper wrap activity that ties healthy eating to team bonding.
records.value: builds stronger athletes and individuals through discipline, teamwork, mentorship, fundamentals, game strategy, mental toughness, and athlete wellness including nutrition education
records.claim: Melissa's coaching philosophy emphasizes building stronger athletes and individuals through discipline, teamwork, mentorship, fundamentals, game strategy, mental toughness, and athlete wellness including nutrition education.
